title: Agentic pack (platform | method | audience), contract 1
description: Shape of a .agent/packs/<kind>/<id>/pack.json. THIS FILE IS EDITOR SUPPORT, NOT THE GATE. The rules that actually matter are cross-file and cross-pack — one owner per slot, one owner per dial, extends resolves to the same kind, incompatible_with refuses a composition — and JSON Schema cannot express any of them because they only exist when two packs are composed. `.agent/scripts/resolve-packs.mjs` is the enforcing implementation; `__tests__/resolve-packs.test.mjs` mutation-tests it. Contract prose: .agent/packs/README.md.

id.description: MUST equal the directory name. The directory is the identity.

kind.description: MUST equal the parent directory. Determines what this pack may own. A source pack (/migrate) owns nothing: additive only, with closed requires + composes_with.

status.description: declares-today = states current inline behaviour verbatim for snapshot comparison; nothing reads it. A deviation from the command prose is a bug in the pack, not an improvement.

scope.description: Which stages this pack has actually been written for. Prevents reading a partial pack as complete.

extends.description: Inherit another pack OF THE SAME KIND; declare only the delta. Merge: additions concatenate, scalars and slots override, templates override.

incompatible_with.description: Compositions this pack refuses. Effect is symmetric — either side declaring it refuses the pair.

composes_with.description: For a source pack: the CLOSED allowlist of packs it may be active with; any other active pack is refused.

requires.description: Source packs only: packs that must all be active, or the composition is refused.

detect.description: How M0 recognises this pack from an existing tree (platform-pack.md § 2).

confidence.description: A strong signal alone resolves. Corroborating signals alone NEVER do.

variables.description: Run-scoped values the pack interpolates, e.g. {router} in a skill name.

workspace.description: SLOT — owned by kind `platform`. Names this platform needs, and WHEN each becomes permanent.

naming.description: Which names are local vs tenant-facing, and when an unresolved tenant-facing name must stop the run.

required_at.description: When an UNRESOLVED tenant-facing name stops the run. intake = the name is written to disk before the spec exists (content-sdk: the editing-host name lands in xmcloud.build.json before the first commit). before_scaffold = nothing is written and nothing enters tenant state until implement, so planning survives a rename. go_live = it only matters at the real-tenant boundary. Was an unschemad two-value enum until 2026-08-28; a pack could declare required_at: "banana" and every gate stayed green.

tenant_facing.description: Names that propagate into tenant state a rename does not undo. Every entry needs a slot in run-manifest.template.json workspace{}.

local.description: Names derivable from the run slug — folders, roots, branches, slugs.

repo_topology.description: How this platform's deployables map onto git repos. STRING form = one fixed answer, not selectable. OBJECT form = the operator picks per run, and `variants` carries what each choice CHANGES — the resolver merges the selected variant over `workspace` / `repo_setup` so a brief shows exactly one coherent answer. Without `variants` the key would be decorative: a value nothing acts on (rule 88).

default.description: Applied when the run recorded no choice. A resolution the operator never made must still be a NAMED one.

values.description: Every value the operator may pick. An unlisted value is an ERROR, never a silent fallback to the default.

operator_selectable.description: true = a stage must ASK. A pack declaring several values without asking is the state BACKLOG item 22 recorded: expressible and unreachable.

resolved_at.description: When the answer must exist. `intake` where it decides the folder, the git init and the build descriptor — all three land before the first commit.

records.description: Run-manifest field the resolved value is written to.

variants.description: Per-value patch, deep-merged over the pack's own top-level declarations. Keys are values from `values`; each value is an object of pack-level keys to override (today: `workspace`, `repo_setup`).

rules.description: Rule files this pack's stages cite. Activation is by citation — .mdc frontmatter is inert (plan § Findings C).

dials.description: Scope-dial presets. ONE OWNER PER DIAL, and it must be the owning kind: ui_variants/rigor -> method; content_authoring/imagery/delivery_loop/delivery_parallelism -> platform; gates/output_verbosity/docs_at_ship/external_reference/track -> audience.

stages.description: Per-stage contributions, keyed by stage name (implement, test, ship, ...).

skill.description: Bare skill name. May interpolate a declared variable, e.g. content-sdk-{router}-router-component-scaffold.

load.description: always is the only machine-checkable policy; the other two carry a model-evaluated predicate.

when.description: Required for mandatory_when (or a topic for when_relevant) — a conditional load with no stated condition is a policy nobody can apply.

hooks.description: Ordered steps at a NAMED anchor. SEVEN anchors: tranche_join was added, and `scaffold` / `preflight_credentials` were REMOVED because they are slots — a name cannot be both.

additions.description: Items appended to a list the CORE owns. Always concatenates — never conflicts.

overrides.description: Replace a stage body or a template file. Range rule: platform -> build/deploy/release stages; method -> intake/spec/design stages; audience -> templates ONLY.

constraints.description: Concatenating list — no ownership, so any kind may contribute.

scaffold.description: SLOT — platform. null permitted WITH a scaffold_reason sibling.

definition_of_done.description: SLOT — platform. Other kinds contribute via additions.definition_of_done_addenda[]. This is the collision case.
